summary: The Plane of Fire is the elemental dominion of flame and destruction. Its blazing citadels, molten rivers, and infernal maws test mortals before they reach the Fire Sovereign’s throne.
history: Formed when elemental forces claimed dominion over flame and lava.
Blazing Citadel rose as the fortress of fire guardians.
Fire Cove became the crucible of molten trials.
Inferno Maw formed as the abyss consuming flame and stone.
Magma Rivers flow endlessly toward the Fire Sovereign’s throne.
